# Format
```{r responders vs nonresponders}
recist_resnon <- recist %>%
  mutate(res_nonresc = ifelse(recist$Category == "PR" | recist$Category == "CR", 
                          "responder", "nonresponder")) %>%
                          select(`Patient ID`, `Patient Type`, Category, 
                                 res_nonresc) %>% drop_na(`Patient ID`)
                       

                      
                          
pfs_resnon <- pfsnonres %>% 
  mutate(res_nonpfs = ifelse(`12-month PFS` == "Yes", "responder", 
                          "nonresponder")) %>% select(`Patient ID`, `12-month PFS`, res_nonpfs)

resnoninfo <- left_join(recist_resnon,pfs_resnon, by = "Patient ID")

write.csv(resnoninfo, "mitox_resnoncombine.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}


```


```{r}
table.input <- ae_att %>%
  select(Patient.ID, Attribution..Final.) %>%
  mutate(`Patient Id` = Patient.ID,
        irAE = ifelse(Attribution..Final. == "Yes", "irAE", "no irAE")) %>%
  full_join(demo.dat) %>%
  mutate(Sex = ifelse(Sex == 'F', 1, 0),
         Metastatic = ifelse(`Patient Type` == 'Met', 1,0),
         Race = ifelse(Race == "White", 1,0)) %>%
  distinct() %>% drop_na(Race) %>% left_join(res_nondat, by = "Patient.ID") %>%
  mutate(Response = res_non)


write.csv(table.input, "mitox_table1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

#manually edited tabone file
table1(data=tabone, ~ Age + Sex + Race + irAE + Cohort + Treatment |Response)



labels <- list(
    variables=list(Sex="Sex",
                   Age="Age (years)",
                   Race="Race",
                   irAE="irAE",
                   Patient.Type= "Patient Type",
                   Treatment= "Treatment"),
    groups=list("","Response"))


strata <- c(list(Total=tabone), split(tabone, tabone$Response))


table1(strata, labels, groupspan=c( 1, 2))


```

```{r}

#manually edited tabone_met file
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]
    y <- unlist(x)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
      
        p <- t.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
       
        p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
    
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```
